column1: # source: Concepticon conceptlists (https://github.com/concepticon/concepticon-data, concepticondata/conceptlists/): Tadmor-2009-100 (Leipzig-Jakarta list, Tadmor, Haspelmath & Taylor 2010), Swadesh-1952-200, Swadesh-1955-100, Pagel-2007-200 (Pagel, Atkinson & Meade 2007, Nature 449), Holman-2008-100 (Holman et al. 2008, ASJP stability).
# licence: Concepticon data CC-BY 4.0 (List et al., Concepticon 3.x); underlying list values from the cited papers.

# lists: LJ100 = Leipzig-Jakarta 100; SW207 = Swadesh 207, built as the union of Swadesh 1952 (200) and Swadesh 1955 (100) by Concepticon id (213 concepts after mapping; the Wikipedia '207' list is this union); SW200 / SW100 mark the source list.

# lj_rank: Leipzig-Jakarta rank (1 = most borrowing-resistant/stable). pagel_rate: Pagel 2007 mean rate of lexical replacement in Indo-European (replacements per 10,000 yr, low = stable); pagel_english_freq: their English usage frequency per million.
# holman_rank / holman_stability: ASJP stability rank and score (Holman et al. 2008, 100 items; rank 1 = most stable).

# stability_class: 1 (most stable, slowest replacement) .. 5 (fastest). Derived, not published: quintile of the Pagel rate among the 200 Pagel concepts where available, else quintile of Holman stability among its 100, else quintile of the LJ rank, else (3 concepts: BERRY, MALE PERSON, HOT OR WARM) a class from general knowledge, marked 'knowledge'. Concepts with no class: 0.

# WOLD1460 rows (2026-11-07): meanings of the World Loanword Database (Haspelmath & Tadmor 2009; Concepticon list Haspelmath-2009-1460, CC-BY 4.0) picked for sample sentences and grammar sketches (WOLD_EXTENSION in the script); stability_class 3-5 by tercile of WOLD's composite rank among them (wold_rank_tercile), pos from WOLD's part of speech.
